premises.text: Current digital tools cannot effectively cut hard materials like metal and glass.
premises.evidence_span: there are hobby laser cutters but they only cut soft materials like wood and plastic. 3D printers are great for complex shapes but again only in plastic. Desktop CNC machines can cut some soft metals but the process is tedious and requires lots of skill.

premises.text: Wazer is a digital tool that uses water to cut through any material with precision.
premises.evidence_span: Wazer is the first desktop water jet cutter. It cuts any material. It cuts with digital precision.

premises.text: Wazer is compact, clean, safe, and quiet to use.
premises.evidence_span: it's compact and contained which makes it clean, safe and quiet to use

premises.text: Wazer's technology is based on pressurizing water combined with abrasive particles.
premises.evidence_span: we pressurize water. We combine it with abrasive sand-like particles at high velocity.

premises.text: Wazer can significantly reduce the time required to cut materials compared to manual methods.
premises.evidence_span: It would have taken three days to cut by hand. Now I can send my digital design to our device, press cut, and walk away. In three hours, the job would be done.

premises.text: Wazer is versatile and can be used by various types of makers.
premises.evidence_span: Because Wazer is so versatile and wedding can cut, it's needed by lots of different types of makers.

value.text: Wazer enables makers to create intricate designs with precision and efficiency.
value.evidence_span: we're really excited to be bringing this amazing technology to workshops everywhere.
